description: The prior opened Jan Möhr report confirms the 5 February student protest but gives no attendance figure. The ≥50 threshold cannot be determined; the exact demand of this gathering also needs separation from later organizational calls.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous crowd estimate or organizer statement and verify the student action’s specific state target without transferring any count from the later 8 February search-only report.

description: The 8 February Jan Möhr Informanté article remains search-only. A gated web open failed at tool level and a separately gated ordinary HTTPS fallback failed DNS resolution before HTTP; neither yielded a body or an observed denial. Related Namibian/NBC headlines are also unopened.
required_followup: Only if still needed, create a new exact-URL receipt, complete the full manual publisher/origin review, read back and hash the note, verify the complete live input path/hash set and phase clock, then request once; preserve the search-only status until body evidence exists.

description: The Windhoek Observer body establishes an NUNW-led mass demonstration and petition concerning Air Namibia liquidation, but its relative page age is unanchored and it gives no exact event date or physical venue. February ownership remains provisional.
required_followup: Find dated contemporaneous coverage or archived publication metadata; distinguish the opened national demonstration from petition records, search-only videos and any regional action.

description: The possible Ohangwena Air Namibia action is known only from search-result text, with no body, turnout or route. Its relationship to the NUNW-led demonstration in E003 is unresolved.
required_followup: Read the exact Omutumwa article under a fresh gate, establish date, local count and event boundaries; do not merge or split national and regional actions by assumption.

description: The possible 24 February Okavango demonstration is supported only by search-result text. The Namibian gate’s full-corpus manual-review prerequisite failed before a note and no request was made; Informanté was not opened. Date, location, demand, state target and threshold remain provisional.
required_followup: Complete a fresh full-corpus manual review for the exact The Namibian URL and, if needed, a separately reviewed gate for Informanté; then verify the occurrence date, event scale, demand target and any relationship between stories.

description: Protester violence, physical closure and all seven event-specific state-response dimensions remain unknown for the five candidates. Search-only headlines and government policy positions are insufficient to code response or silence.
required_followup: Use opened, event-specific sources to establish conduct, event end and any state accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, deliberate ignoring, killings or shootings; otherwise retain unknown.

description: No physical end date is established for any candidate. The Jan Möhr actions’ same-campaign/distinct-event status and Air Namibia national/local boundaries are unresolved; no verified February-to-March continuous gathering was found in this open-web pass.
required_followup: Search adjacent-month reporting before setting event end or continuity; do not infer closure from last publication, month end or a later policy decision.

description: Other result headlines mention teachers’ salary plans, nurses, Khorixas police-brutality demonstrations, Hai//om farm sales, GBV and a youth protest about a Parliament building. These remain undated/unopened leads rather than February events or evidence of no event.
required_followup: Date and open each plausible contemporaneous lead, determine whether an actual public gathering began in February, and seek crowd and domestic-state-demand evidence.

description: The open-web search log preserves 30 actual search actions and 739 ordered returned-result headers, including local, regional, international and official-source leads. The method does not replicate LexisNexis and does not provide comprehensive coverage in Oshiwambo or other local languages. Search completeness and absence are not established.
required_followup: Obtain systematic archive and language coverage if available; search local and regional outlets week by week and preserve query/capture provenance.

description: NUNW event-related petition, video and press references may describe one event or related phases; the two Okavango news headlines may share an origin. Publisher independence and written-story relationships are not established by titles or common subject.
required_followup: Read source bodies and explicit attribution before treating reports as independent confirmation or separating events; do not infer syndication from topic, outlet name or byline alone.
